query.description: Changes at or after this time (alternative to `since`)

request.description: Delta feed for lists that went offline: ids and versions of everything the caller may see that changed after `since`, oldest first, across the requested `types` (`lead`, `assignment`, `follow_up`; default all). Send `nextCursor` back as `since` until `hasMore` is false; refetch an item when its version is newer than the cached one. Staff see what their role allows; a CA firm sees its own assignments, leads it holds and its follow-ups. Pair with the `/v1/realtime` socket for live updates. Any signed-in context. Pass `updatedSince` (ISO date-time) instead of `since` to catch up from a point in time, for example when a realtime connection drops: it returns every change made at or after that moment.
